svg.aria-label: Ordered parallel encoding: a bounded queue of result slots, in batch order, limits the batches in flight and restores their order
svg.title: Ordered parallel encoding: a bounded queue of result slots, in batch order, limits the batches in flight and restores their order
svg.text: for each batch, the grouper first queues an empty slot, in batch order

g.text: the grouper queues a slot for each batch it hands out: #0…#3
every slot is taken, so the grouper holds #4 back
#1, #2 and #3 finish first and wait in their slots for #0
#0 arrives, and the writer takes #0…#3 in order, freeing their slots
each freed slot lets the grouper hand out one more batch
however slow one batch is, at most four batches are in flight
